# Latest results, 2026-11-23 (generated by `collect.py`; its docstring names every run)

Every number: chr1 of the test tumor, benchmark regions, rtg vcfeval, PASS calls, P / R / F1. "after" = after the population filter. Seed 0 unless a seed is named. HCC1395T chr1 is held out of every multi-tumor model; HG008T and COLO829T are unseen tumors for the four-line models and have chr1 held out of the six-tumor models.
